content: For ids that must merge across independent sources (e.g. multi-machine sync), make them globally unique AT creation (per-source prefix/tag + local sequence) instead of building a reactive collision-detection + remap protocol. The proactive scheme is strictly simpler: plain union-by-id merge, no remap, no reference-rewrite cascade.
context: T-043 lesson ids: chose `L-<sourceTag>-<seq>` (6-hex per-install tag) over an earlier plan to have the server re-mint colliding L-NNN ids and return a remap. Reviewer challenged the original "switching to uuids breaks UX" justification — it didn't (ids are agent-facing, ~0 migration cost), and the proactive scheme deleted an entire remap mechanism from the design.
title: Design id collisions out at creation rather than detecting and remapping
